task_text: A typhoon is approaching and will hit in about 10 minutes. All windows and doors need to be shut, and anything outside or loose inside should be secured.

central_instructions.R1: Secure any loose light objects in the kitchen and pass them to R2 if needed.
central_instructions.R2: Move to the living room to assist R4 in securing light objects and closing windows and doors.
central_instructions.R3: Secure any loose light objects in the living room and pass them to R4 if needed.
central_instructions.R4: Close all windows and doors in the living room and secure any loose light objects with assistance from R2.
